hypothesis: Does isolating a question-only preliminary answer reduce retrieval-induced patient/mechanism contamination?
source: MedCounterFact ACL2026 section7 and AppendixT; original question-only prior plus evidence adaptation, not a novel paradigm or original task replication.
scope: All13 exposed original HIV ART questions, no newly created polarity variants or extra synthetic tasks. Author-answer agreement, not new clinical ground truth.
controls: prior: question-only draft then full-context review; revision: full-context draft then same review. Each arm2 original-model calls, 2048 tokens per call; native guided/unguided JSON, seed42, temperature.7, batch4. Draft revision is also the one-call full-context control.
permissions: Current question/native options and original retrieval only. Final stage retains the exact full original context. No original response, gold, ratings, author explanation or source identifiers enters inference.
decision: One common candidate on both models. All invalid outputs and harms retained. Review patient and mechanism statements, not only agreement. Do not choose arms per item/model or upgrade these exposed13 to validation.
attribution: The whole source-isolation treatment changes first-pass retrieval visibility plus the corresponding true draft-origin label in the final pass; do not claim to isolate these two factors.
